permits.limitation: Discovery walks the record-number space by prefix and year, because eTRAKiT publishes no recently-changed feed. A record whose number falls outside the configured prefixes is not discovered.

transportation.limitation: Caltrans state projects only. Live traffic events and work zones are implemented but unpromoted.
